description: Shared navigation outlet corpus asserted by both the C# engine (Engine.Specs/for_EffectiveNavigation) and the TypeScript engine (engine/for_effectiveNavigation). structure is the default application structure; a case may carry its own. A view resolves one outlet of navigation (with its <outlet>Buttons outlet of actions) for the application (no module) or for one module and lists the effective items as id|origin|locked or editable|resolved feature|slot|icon|reason, sub-items indented by two spaces. editCases run an edit helper, then apply the edits it returned. Diagnostics are the shared codes, messages and entries of diagnoseNavigationOutlets.
